mandate: C328 — test the cross-sectional intraday RETURN SIGN-RUN / DIRECTIONAL STREAK SEASONAL DISLOCATION mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (864 pre-registered configs). Per bar-of-day bucket, trailing L same-tod occurrences: streak=sign_run (current same-sign run length), signchg=trailing count of sign_chg (sign-change / zero-crossing count), streak_ewm=causal EWM of sign_run; score=-dislocation vs trailing same-tod mean. Signals: streak_dev, signchg_dev, streak_ewm_dev. Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and sign-streak-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: denominators/values<=0 -> NaN; same-tod trailing stats NaN-aware min_periods=L excluding NaN obs; zero-variance/insufficient-obs NaNs fail-closed (NaN bars weight 0); raw cache fields are zero-NaN real derivations.

data_quality.note: sign-streak NaN share is dominated by structural warmup (first ~L same-tod occurrences per bucket) plus min_periods windows; zero-variance adds negligible mass.

methodology.buckets: bar-of-day (tod)=seconds-of-day//300 (0..287), exact 288 bars per UTC day.
methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; sign_run=consecutive same-sign run length (sign_run[0]=0); sign_chg=sign-change indicator 0/1 (sign_chg[0]=0). Zero NaN raw fields.
methodology.signals: per bar-of-day bucket over trailing L same-tod bars: streak=sign_run[t]; signchg=count of sign_chg over window; streak_ewm=causal EWM of sign_run. score=-(v-trailing_mean_L(v@tod)) (streak_ewm vs ewm baseline); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 864 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config signal nets vs streak_placebo (per-asset permuted returns, same positions); shares=|net|/sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
